channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Green Goa at a Crossroads as Section 39A Sparks Statewide Protests Over Land Conversion
item.description: Thousands across Goa are protesting Section 39A of the TCP Act, fearing it enables land conversions that threaten ecology, livelihoods, and community rights.

item.title: Amid Court Bomb Threat Wave, Suspected Device Found Near Sainthia Railway Tracks in West Bengal
item.description: Security halted trains after a suspected bomb was found 1.5 km from Sainthia amid court threat emails.

item.title: IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Advocates Fair Compensation For News Creators In AI Era
item.description: At India AI Summit 2026, government backed compensating publishers for AI-trained content amid disputes.

item.title: Telangana’s ₹6,000 Crore Monthly Salary Bill Raises Fiscal Sustainability and Equity Questions Statewide
item.description: A decade after statehood, Telangana’s salary and pension bill quadrupled, sparking debate on equity and fiscal priorities.

item.title: Kerala High Court Halts The Release of ‘Kerala Story 2’, Slams CBFC for Breaching Certification Guidelines
item.description: The Kerala High Court stayed 'The Kerala Story 2 - Goes Beyond' for 15 days, ruling the CBFC prima facie failed to follow its own certification guidelines.

item.title: 300 Students Boycott Exams After 40 Barred Over Overnight Party At IIM Nagpur, Ban Later Revoked
item.description: After attending an overnight farewell party, 40 MBA students were barred, prompting 300-student protest before revocation.

item.title: Logical Take: Two Fatal Crashes, Young Drivers, Weak Enforcement – How Reckless Driving Keeps Killing Indians
item.description: Two deadly crashes involving teenage drivers expose how weak enforcement, social privilege, and a culture of impunity continue to turn Indian roads into killing fields.

item.title: Pakistan Declares Open War, Conducts Airstrikes Killing Over 130 Taliban Fighters Amid Border Escalation
item.description: Pakistan and Afghanistan engage in deadly border clashes as Islamabad launches airstrikes in retaliation.

item.title: Govt Mandates Sale Of 20% Ethanol-Blended Petrol At Every Pump Nationwide From April 1
item.description: India is driving towards a greener future, but millions of older vehicle owners, going green comes at a price.

item.title: JNU ‘Long March’ Over VC’s Alleged Casteist Remark Ends In Clashes, 14 Arrested
item.description: JNU student protest over alleged casteist remarks escalates into clashes, detentions, and debate on equity.
